SELECT delivery_employee_id AS riderId,
-- 总订单数：已接单 / 派送中 / 已完成 SUM( CASE WHEN status IN (3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS totalOrderCount,
-- 有效订单数：已完成 SUM( CASE WHEN status = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS validOrderCount
FROM orders WHERE order_type = 1 AND pay_status = 1 AND delivery_employee_id IS NOT NULL AND order_time BETWEEN #{beginTime} AND #{endTime}
GROUP BY delivery_employee_id

SELECT delivery_employee_id AS riderId, COUNT(*) AS finishOrderCount FROM orders WHERE order_type = 1 AND pay_status = 1 AND status = 5 AND delivery_employee_id IS NOT NULL AND order_time BETWEEN #{beginTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY delivery_employee_id
